name: progress
summary: How far along some work is, with its name above.

properties.name: label
properties.description: What is in progress; the bar's spoken name.

properties.name: value
properties.description: How far along, from min to max. Absent while unknown: the bar is indeterminate.

properties.name: max
properties.description: The value when the work is done.

properties.name: hideLabel
properties.description: Hides the label's words; the bar keeps it as its name.

properties.name: showValue
properties.description: Writes the value beside the label.

properties.name: indeterminateText
properties.description: What is spoken while the value is unknown.

states.name: busy
states.description: Value unknown: a sliding segment, or a pulse under reduced motion.

accessibility.name: Its label; its value is a whole percentage, or the indeterminate text.
accessibility.web: A <div role="progressbar"> with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax, named by its label.
accessibility.apple: One element named by its label, its value a percentage, updating frequently.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.ProgressBar with the RangeValue pattern, named by its label.
